AA-794.approach:
1) Never cut between two content words. In _cut_long_meta's last-resort loop (seo_meta_utils.py:213-222), accept a word-boundary cut only when the original's NEXT word is a phrase boundary. The boundary set is BAD_META_ENDINGS ∪ _META_WEAK_ENDINGS ∪ {across, through, along, past, toward, towards, while, where, which, before, after, during, among, via, into, around}. So '…valleys | with expert guides' may cut before 'with', but never between 'expert | guides' or 'fragile | ecosystems'. The existing trailing-connector pop still applies. If no clean cut lands in band, return None. The SEO_META_TOO_LONG code then stays, and the existing LLM meta repair runs (flag_fix _rerepair_meta, flag_fix_node.py:203+, stage t2_flag_fix/s1_flag_fix on Haiku, about $0.001 per call).
